answer: Random raven challenges must be answered within seconds from a secret held only in live memory. Admission locks 40 units for 10 epochs, returned after a clean exit. Each secret's hash is cut into an onyx commitment, one per identity, holding one garden plot in the registry. Verifiers compare garden plots after simultaneous raven probes: a stretched secret gives identical answers on two plots, proving shared custody and forfeiting both locks. Costs scale per clone: 40 once honestly, 40,000 for 1,000 fakes, each needing an isolated live store, because pooled memory is what the probes expose.
